d073CreationDiagnostics: Canonical AIGC -2 has no applicable creation date and emits no creation anomaly. Ordinary source missing/conflicting/after-observation remains a raw-field observation, but affectedMetrics=[] because earliest source/business date resolves display/classification. Do not mislabel these as pending new/history or collector failure. Other missing metrics/days remain unchanged.
scope: Local read-only project/day diagnosis; not collector execution or configuration mutation

missingDetails.materialId: canonical ID or null for missing account day
missingDetails.affectedMetrics: string[]; empty on explicit nonpositive-spend metric rows
missingDetails.sourceVersionId: current day version ID or null for no current day

response.missingDetailTotal: total matching detail rows before visible cap
response.missingDetailsTruncated: true iff missingDetailTotal exceeds 1000; ask maintenance to narrow dates

days.date: ISO date; ascending; exactly one row per requested date

currentVersion.updatedAt: ISO instant; version record timestamp, not collector freshness

rules: currentVersion is null exactly when state is MISSING. EMPTY is a verified complete account day with zero fact rows, not missing.
availableDays includes EMPTY; missingDays + availableDays = queriedDays. isolatedDays counts days with one or more ISOLATED versions, independently of coverage.
Current facts and version metadata must be read in one read-only REPEATABLE_READ snapshot; identity, pointers, rows and hashes are checked before returning any success.
Only current fact payloads are rehashed; previous/isolated versions are metadata diagnostics, not independently payload-validated in this endpoint.
Missing current evidence does not establish collection failure or an overdue collection. observedRange describes stored facts, not scheduling obligations.

missingDetails covers source creation metadata and five dashboard base metrics only, not a general 33-field platform. Every requested fact missing one of these fields is observed; no numeric raw data included. Resolve creation conflicts using only history <= queried end. Null creation on one row is still a field observation even if another source row supplies a consistent date.

Field observations sorted date ascending, canonical material ID text ascending (null as empty), then field ascending. Return first 1000 and explicit total/truncation. Missing account day has NO_CURRENT_VERSION, not fabricated collector failure. Unknown/invalid source creation date is MISSING_CREATION_DATE; do not invent cause.

Affected metrics: ordinary raw createdDate anomalies have empty impact under D-073 earliest source/business-date resolution; AIGC creation is not applicable and not an anomaly. spend=>all; gmv=>roi; impressions=>ctr/cpm; clicks=>ctr/cvr/cpc; orders=>orders/cvr. For explicitly zero or negative spend rows, latter four do not enter current calculations and affectedMetrics is empty. Source version ID binds observation to current validated fact evidence.
No real account IDs, source filesystem paths, credentials, raw material rows or driver exception details are returned.

Missing dates and isolated inputs require maintenance attention; no automatic activation, import, collection, deletion or configuration writes. Green current coverage does not imply all historical metrics exist.
HTTP 400 INVALID_QUERY, 404 PROJECT_NOT_ENABLED, 503 OPERATIONS_QUERY_UNAVAILABLE; failures never masquerade as an empty success.

localPreflight.boundary: Revalidate one configured local source without any database connection. SOURCE_READY is not import success, current-version identity, or authorization to activate a changed version. NO_CONFIGURED_INPUT is not proof no archive exists.

acceptance: Existing UI has a maintenance toggle and separate date query; switching does not change review/TOP query values or trigger collection.
Real local database shows complete manual and auto days, confirmed empty day, and dates outside stored coverage as missing with accurate semantics.
Synthetic tests cover isolated versions, mismatched identities/pointers/hashes, invalid range, failed and stale UI requests.
Single-day source preflight is exercised on real auto/manual/empty and unconfigured dates; source bytes and database facts remain unchanged.
